scripts.check:no-js: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),bad=[],skip=new Set(['node_modules','dist','build','.git','.vercel']),allowed=new Set(['eslint.config.js']);const walk=d=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name),n=p.replaceAll('\\','/').replace(/^\.\//,'');if(e.isDirectory()){if(!skip.has(e.name))walk(p)}else if(/\.(?:js|jsx)$/.test(e.name)&&!allowed.has(n))bad.push(n)}};walk('.');if(bad.length){console.error('New JavaScript files are not allowed in the partner client:\n'+bad.join('\n'));process.exit(1)}"
